headline: Rolling Loud India has been announced for December 12–13, 2026 🇮🇳🔥 The two-day festival
body: Rolling Loud India has been announced for December 12–13, 2026 🇮🇳🔥 The two-day festival has revealed its dates, with the lineup still to be announced. No performers have been confirmed in this announcement, so we’ll have to wait to see who’s taking the stage. 👀 India has its dates… now who’s hoping for a North American announcement next? 😭 Who would you want headlining? 👇 📸: /
